sources.title: napari issue #7962: [Shapes] Consider that layer list contextual menu Shapes to Labels use LayerList.extent
sources.exact_locator: Issue body: 'the Shapes.extent will be used, so you will get a Labels layer that does not match the size of the image layer ... when you save the layer for using later it doesn't match what you expect'
sources.applicability: Chain-1 anchor: annotation-derived rasters must be sized by the image extent, not the annotation extent; directly motivates scope/extent binding in the data contract.
